name: readConfig
description: Reads a live server-held configuration value of the app's environment; a strict value is read from the server each time and fails closed when it cannot be (DAT-094, DAT-097).

typeParameters.name: T
typeParameters.description: The type of the value, named by `type`: string, int, decimal or bool. Without `type` the step's output cannot be read.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: The type the value must have; the step's output has this type. A value of another type fails the step (PLX-6074), and a decimal is read exactly from the string the server carries.
